description: This file defines the PHP class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Optional, which is a subclass of HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Required. It models a child element definition that allows a set of elements with no required children, primarily used in HTML purification logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Optional
classes.description: A class representing an optional child element definition that can have no children but allows a set of elements.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates a set of child tokens, allowing for empty sets or whitespace, overriding parent validation logic.
